title: Studio's create doors for a new object, a new permission set and a new app publish without If-None-Match, so a same-name item published in the window is replaced
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As6kDA9BVrMsBR9rmrJ

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · found by the #36726 dev (os-dev-report comment 7129863132 on #36726), outside that card's surface; PR #36958 (that card) does not touch it. Pre-existing on main 53857591. Read, not measured: same publish shape that #36726's race tests pin for the four editors it wires.

## What happens
Three Studio create doors write the draft with `ifNoneMatch: '*'` and then publish with `publishSavedItem(..., false)` and no create assertion on the publish:
- new object: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:3132`
- new permission set: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:7379` (the comment above it says so: "A set published in that window is not refused by it.")
- new app: `newAppDoor.ts:72`

So an item of the same name that another writer published between the draft write and the publish is replaced by the new one. PR #36958 (#36726) makes the publish of the new flow, new hook, new action and first extension send `If-None-Match: *`. These three were outside its surface.

## Done when
- Each of the three create publishes sends `If-None-Match: *` the way #36958 wires the flow, hook and action creates. A refused publish takes back the draft it wrote and says that the name is taken.
- One pin per door: another writer publishes the same name in the window, and the create is refused. Plus one ablation.

reach: Studio new object / new permission set / new app (public UI doors), read from source; repro not measured.
Business reason: a create can silently replace a published object, permission set or app of the same name.
Reader: the o7-studio area of seat repo:objectstack#7.
Dedupe: `If-None-Match create publish` → 2 (#36726 parent; a seat post); `newAppDoor publish` → 0; `permission Save last-writer-wins` → 1 (a seat post).
Suggested-grade: p3 · area:build · Bug · admins, rare (a narrow window between two writes) · read.
